reason: I'd probably run the 30 free receipts to see how it copes, but I won't pay $19 a month forever when I or a friend could wire up the same thing with n8n and ChatGPT for a few dollars of API. It's a nice idea, but it's not hard to build, and that's exactly the kind of tool I make myself.
objection: Will a new little bot still be here next year, or will I wake up one day and find my staff's receipts aren't going anywhere and I have to build my own anyway?
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial showed it reading our messy handwritten notes and Indonesian transfer screenshots far better than anything I could hack together, plus a cheap yearly plan with a clear promise of what happens to my sheet if they shut down.
